messages:
Maria (CS Manager): Heads-up — kicking off NovaWorks preview onboarding tomorrow 9:00 AM PT. Need an SE to cover a 15-min enablement demo + a short integration checklist. Who can own the demo?
Devon (Solutions Eng): I can take 9:00 AM PT. Planning to show SDK quickstart + streaming toggle and a tiny KV cache example. Will need staging creds. :+1:
Aj Patel (AE): FYI client flagged seat counts and renewal terms as a possible risk if they don’t see value by EOW. Recommend weekly check-ins + an adoption task list to keep momentum. :eyes:
Maria (CS Manager): Agreed. Proposed plan: 1) 15-min enablement tomorrow 9a PT, 2) weekly 30-min sync (Weds), 3) sample prompts + health dashboard. I’ll own the onboarding checklist. Notion: https://redwoodhq.notion.site/NovaWorks-Preview-Onboard-123
Olivia (PM): Love that. Let’s capture three signal metrics for success: active endpoints, median 1k-token latency, and a qualitative accuracy score on 50 sample prompts. I’ll wire these into the eval dashboard.
Devon (Solutions Eng): For staging creds — @OnboardBot can you grant the NovaWorks team access to project `preview-nova` with role `viewer` and a demo token?
OnboardBot: Request received — provisioning token now. ETA ~3 min. /audit: requested by maria_cs.
Aj Patel (AE): I scheduled a recurring Wed sync 11:00 AM ET / 8:00 AM PT. Invite sent to client and CC'd Legal for a short renewal-term touchpoint in week 2.
Maria (CS Manager): Quick ask — can we create a 2-week success plan PDF for customers: objectives, milestones, acceptance criteria? @Olivia can you draft the one-pager?
Olivia (PM): Yep — I’ll draft the one-pager + success criteria and drop it in the NovaWorks Notion page by EOD.
Devon (Solutions Eng): Demo prep checklist for tomorrow: SDK snippet, 2 sample prompts (classification + completion), latency dashboard link, rollback plan. Quick SDK curl to use in demo:```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \\n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\n  -d '{"model":"rw-1.5","input":"Summarize: ...","max_tokens":200}'
```
Maria (CS Manager): Also want a micro-survey after enablement (3 Qs: clarity, confidence, blockers) so we can triage issues quickly and assign owners.
Aj Patel (AE): I’ll own the survey + follow-up. Escalation rule: if adoption < 10 calls/day by day 7, route to Renewal Ops for a retention play.
Devon (Solutions Eng): :thumbsup: I’ll record the demo and clip the key 2-min segments to add to the docs.
OnboardBot: Provision complete — token `preview_nova_abc123` created (ephemeral). Reminder: rotate after demo. :lock:
Maria (CS Manager): Thanks all. I’ll post the final runbook here 30 min before the call and include the short checklist + client-facing one-pager. See you at 9:00 AM PT!
